What To Expect
Overview
Something For Everyone at Universal Studios Hollywood. Experience Hollywood. Dining and Entertainment. Rides and Attractions. Seasonal Events.
Ever wanted to come face-to-face with dinosaurs? Or experience the mysterious halls of a real-life Hogwarts™? At Universal Studios Hollywood, you can do both (and more!) when you explore 10 out-of-this-world themed lands all at one single park.
SUPER NINTENDO WORLD™

A New Way to Play! SUPER NINTENDO WORLD™ takes you into the world of Super Mario™. Battle Team Bowser on Mario Kart™: Bowser’s Challenge, dine at Toadstool Cafe™, and level up with exclusive merch from the 1-UP Factory™ store.
Top Attraction: Mario Kart™ : Bowser's Challenge
Top Dining: Toadstool Cafe™
The Wizarding World of Harry Potter™

Step into a world full of magic and excitement. Soar with Harry Potter above Hogwarts™ castle, see a wizard be chosen by their wand at Ollivanders™, explore the shops of Hogsmeade™, and experience pulse-pounding rides and attractions that transport you into a world of spells and thrills. It's all here.

Top Attraction: Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey™
Top Entertainment: Triwizard Spirit Rally, Frog Choir
Top Dining: Three Broomsticks™
Jurassic World

Step onto an island of natural beauty and hidden danger. Come face-to-face with dinosaurs as they stalk you through a land altered by science. Watch towering Indominus Rex as she battles T-Rex in an epic showdown that will have your adrenaline pumping. And get your chance to pet Blue the Velociraptor.

Top Attraction: Jurassic World - The Ride

Top Entertainment: Raptor Encounter

Top Dining: Jurassic Cafe
Transformers Metrobase

Prepare yourself for the greatest battle you'll ever ride. Meet Optimus Prime, Megatron and Bumblebee live and in person before you join them in a fight against the Decepticons for the fate of the human race.

Top Attraction: TRANSFORMERS: The Ride-3D, Revenge of the Mummy - The Ride
WaterWorld

A world where dry land is a forgotten dream. Join an adventure that surges with jumping jet-skiers, perilous plunges, firefights, massive explosions, and an in-your-face plane crash.

Top Entertainment: WaterWorld
